title: I’m making a Vib-Ribbon-inspired rhythm game that turns your music into levels
author: HorribleGentics
selftext:
I’m building **NEBULA**: import a song, and it generates the notes you play. Match the incoming shapes as your character morphs and the world reacts to the music.

**I use AI-assisted tools during development.**

To tackle the age old problem of procedural music games, levels feeling off beat at times or random. I used the golden corpus model of machine learning.

(a fixed set of 10 real songs, 1 of each genre and tested across Easy, Normal, and Hard. That gives me 30 repeatable song/difficulty cases to compare when I change the generator, so improving one track doesn’t quietly break another.)

As well as machine learning for sounds both corpuses needed to be compatible with each other:

(synthetic audio corpus, including sine-wave tests: 20 controlled test cases with things like clicks, sustained tones, frequency changes, silence, and different rhythmic patterns. Because those sounds are deliberately constructed, I can check whether the generator is reacting to the musical events that are actually there.)

The visuals build on **projectM**, with custom reactive worlds and lighting that brings the background’s colors onto the player and notes. NEBULA builds on projectM’s audio-reactive visuals with extra reactions driven by beat timing, musical intensity, changes between song sections, and your gameplay.

I commissioned a talented artist to help redesign the player characters and notes.[RiccDraws](https://charri1108.artstation.com/). Using his design i have created alot more faces to unlock.

The song library is connected to the **Audius** api so the game has access to millions of songs to play.

**Again I use AI-assisted tools during development.**

What’s your honest first impression? Does it look fun, confusing, or too visually busy?

[Watch the gameplay here.](https://youtu.be/na906aV3jhw)⁠ 

I’m away from my PC, but I’m planning to upload an **updated playable demo later today** on [itch.io](https://bigmecha.itch.io/nebula)⁠. The current download is still the older build.

It has been around 166 days since my last update so looking at the visuals might be a bit jarring.
